# AX-00 baseline freeze — graphi CLI help
#
# Frozen rendering of the user-facing CLI verbs: the top-level blurb, the
# subcommand listing with its Stable/Labs markers, and every verb's own help.
# Tier markers are DERIVED (cmd/graphi/help.go stabilityMarker →
# surfaces/mcp.IsStableOperation), so a re-tiering shows up here as a diff.
# Regenerate deliberately: GRAPHI_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test ./cmd/graphi -run TestAX00


===== graphi help =====
graphi: run with no arguments to index the current repo and open the local UI in your browser.

Stability taxonomy (SCOPE-01): 🟢 Stable — the 12 frozen product operations, on Go, over CLI + MCP stdio (this is the GA scope); 🧪 Labs — kept in-tree, not a stable promise. On a non-Go language a Stable operation is Preview, not GA. Canonical tiers: docs/stability-tiers.md. Full matrix: docs/coverage-matrix.md.

Stable operations:
  graphi sync                 update the graph to match the checked-out code (run after a branch switch)
  graphi status               is the graph current? (read-only; --json)
  graphi rebuild              re-index the repo from scratch
  graphi search <query>       lexical / symbol search over the graph
  graphi callers <symbol>     who calls a symbol (also: callees, references, definition, neighborhood)
  graphi impact <symbol>      blast radius of a change
  graphi explain-symbol <s>   compact, cited symbol identity summary
  graphi related-files <t>    ranked, cited read-first file list
  graphi change-risk <t>      evidence-based local blast-radius estimate
  graphi agent-brief          bounded, cited task-start context packet

Labs & tooling (not a stable promise):
  graphi symbol-context <s>   unified single-call symbol view (definition, snippet, tests, risk)
  graphi task-context <text>  free-text task → ranked, token-budgeted context bundle
  graphi repo-overview        one-call repository summary (structure, languages, entrypoints)
  graphi test-impact <t>      which tests must run for a change (must_run/recommended/unaffected)
  graphi change-impact <t>    Change Risk 2.0: dependents, covering tests, reasons, risk
  graphi hotspots             churn × centrality file ranking with bus-factor warnings
  graphi search-hybrid <q>    embedding-free hybrid search (identifier + path + degree)
  graphi architecture         community/layer view of the graph (Louvain + dependency direction)
  graphi architecture-violations  cycles, back-edges, high coupling, god modules
  graphi dead-code            scored dead-code candidates with exclusion reasons
  graphi framework-map        routes, events, DI components from recorded annotations
  graphi snapshot [<name>]    list or freeze named graph states of this repo
  graphi compare <a> <b>      diff two named graph states ('current' = live graph)
  graphi doctor               run read-only diagnostic checks
  graphi setup                register graphi's MCP server in local MCP clients
  graphi upgrade -print       print the upgrade command without running it
  graphi ui                   index this repo and open the local UI
  graphi claude               register graphi's MCP server in Claude Code
  graphi analyze <name> ...   run a Labs analyzer (taint, pdg, contracts, …)

Advanced (long forms):
  graphi index [-root <repo>] [-db path] [-meta dir] [--full]   (explicit-path form of sync/rebuild)
  graphi query <op> -symbol <id> [-depth N]
  graphi analyze <name> -symbol <id> [-direction forward|reverse] [-max-nodes N]

Details on any subcommand:  graphi help <subcommand>   (or: graphi <subcommand> --help)
registered languages (Go is GA; every other language is Preview — see docs/stability-tiers.md): [bash c c_sharp cpp css go hcl java javascript json kotlin lua markdown php python ruby rust sql toml tsx typescript yaml]
subcommands: sync, rebuild, status, snapshot, compare, query, search, index, savings, analyze, refactor-preview, refactor, undo, mcp, daemon, http, setup, setup-embedder, doctor, privacy-audit, upgrade, version, help, parse <file>

===== graphi help <unknown> (the verb listing with tier markers) =====
exit code: 1
graphi: unknown subcommand "__no_such_subcommand__"
known subcommands:
  (🟢 stable operations unmarked · [labs] = kept in-tree, not a stable promise)
  (GA = the stable operations on Go over CLI + MCP stdio; other languages are Preview. See docs/stability-tiers.md)
  agent-brief        bounded, cited task-start context packet for agents
  analyze            [labs] run a registered analyzer over the graph
  architecture       [labs] automatic architecture view: Louvain communities layered by dependency direction (labs)
  architecture-violations [labs] cycles, back-edges, high coupling, god modules on the community graph (labs)
  change-impact      [labs] Change Risk 2.0: changed symbols, public API, dependents, covering tests, reasons, risk (labs)
  change-risk        evidence-based local blast-radius estimate (low/medium/high/unknown)
  claude             [labs] register graphi's MCP server in Claude Code (alias for `setup`)
  compare            [labs] diff two named graph states (snapshot names, or 'current' for the live graph)
  compare-branches   [labs] graph-level diff of two graphi SQLite snapshots (paths, never git refs)
  compound           [labs] compound / Cypher-style graph query (SEED/HOP/WHERE/MAXDEPTH)
  conflicts-prs      [labs] inter-PR conflict detection
  critique-review    [labs] graph-evidence critique of an existing PR review
  daemon             [labs] hot-index Unix-socket daemon lifecycle
  dead-code          [labs] scored dead-code candidates with explicit exclusion reasons (labs)
  diagnose           [labs] graph-derived diagnostics + suggested code-actions (high-confidence by default)
  distill            [labs] distill a session into a compact decision record
  doctor             [labs] read-only diagnostic checkup for binary, PATH, MCP clients, DB, privacy, and local-first invariants
  explain-symbol     compact, cited symbol identity summary (definition, callers, callees, references)
  find-clones        [labs] edge-profile clone detection
  framework-map      [labs] application view from recorded framework annotations: routes, events, DI (labs)
  help               [labs] print general help, or detailed help for one subcommand
  hotspots           [labs] churn × dependency-centrality file ranking with bus-factor warnings (labs)
  http               [labs] read-only loopback HTTP REST + SSE surface
  index              ingest a repo into a durable store (advanced long form of sync/rebuild; --full forces a cold pass; optional --semantic embedding pass)
  inline             [labs] inline refactor over the edit saga (single-line initializer targets)
  list-prs           [labs] read-only forge enumeration of open PRs (GITHUB_TOKEN/GITHUB_REPOSITORY env)
  mcp                [labs] MCP stdio server (Stable tools by default; explicit -labs opt-in for experimental tools); -root or the GRAPHI_ROOT env var (flag wins) pins the repository root for clients that launch the server outside the repo and supply no MCP roots; with -db, -meta names the sidecar dir like the CLI verbs
  memory             [labs] agent memory operations
  parse              [labs] parse a single file through the registry (the original default)
  pr-comment         [labs] sticky PR review comment + optional risk-threshold merge gate
  privacy-audit      [labs] print the local-first proof (CGo scan + canary egress guard); non-zero on violation
  query              structural query over the graph (callers|callees|references|definition|neighborhood)
  query-strict       [labs] run a stable query, then exclude result edges below a confidence tier; excluded counts stay visible (filtered emptiness is never bare emptiness), optional fail-closed policy preflight
  rebuild            re-index the repo from scratch (cold full pass — for a damaged index, after an upgrade, or when doctor recommends it)
  refactor           [labs] commit a refactor through the atomic edit saga
  refactor-preview   [labs] impact-set preview of a refactor, no mutation
  related-files      ranked, cited read-first file list around a symbol, path, or task
  repo-overview      [labs] one-call repository summary: structure, languages, entrypoints, central symbols, tests, boundaries (labs)
  safe-delete        [labs] reference-safety-gated delete (removes the declaration line only)
  savings            [labs] session token-savings readout from a ledger a prior MCP/daemon session wrote
  search             lexical / symbol search; -semantic runs the optional embedding search
  search-ast         [labs] structural AST pattern query
  search-hybrid      [labs] embedding-free hybrid search: identifier segments + path + graph degree (labs)
  setup              [labs] register graphi's MCP stdio server into local MCP clients' configs; --project instead writes the repo's .mcp.json with the session root pinned (mcp -root), or with --attach the auto-managed per-repo store pinned (mcp -db/-meta)
  setup-embedder     [labs] print how to opt in to the optional semantic search (offline)
  skillgen           [labs] deterministic skill generation from a procedure description
  snapshot           [labs] list, freeze, or delete named graph states of this repo (for graphi compare)
  status             report whether the graph matches the checked-out code (read-only; exit 0 current, 1 actionable, 2 error)
  suggest-reviewers  [labs] ranked candidate-reviewer recommender for a touched set
  symbol-context     [labs] unified single-call symbol view: definition + snippet, hierarchy, callers/callees/references, covering tests, risk (labs)
  sync               bring the graph up to date with the checked-out code (incremental, flagless; run it after a branch switch)
  task-context       [labs] free-text task → ranked, cited, token-budgeted context bundle with read order (labs)
  test-impact        [labs] which tests must run for a change: must_run / recommended / probably_unaffected / unknown (labs)
  triage-prs         [labs] graph-derived multi-PR triage ranking
  trust-report       [labs] report the graph's trust surface: snapshot state, confidence tiers, coverage gaps, boundaries, optional policy verdict (read-only; exit 0 PASS/current, 1 WARN, 2 error, 3 FAIL, 4 UNKNOWN/unavailable)
  ui                 [labs] index the current repo and open the local graph UI (alias for bare `graphi`)
  undo               [labs] reverse an applied edit by its undo token
  upgrade            [labs] user-initiated self-update to the latest release (never automatic)
  version            [labs] print version / commit / build date stamped into the binary

===== per-verb help =====

--- graphi help agent-brief ---
graphi agent-brief — bounded, cited task-start context packet for agents
usage:   graphi agent-brief [-topic <topic>] [-ledger path]
example: graphi agent-brief -topic "engine/agenttools/brief"

--- graphi help analyze ---
graphi analyze — [labs] run a registered analyzer over the graph
usage:   graphi analyze <analyzer> -symbol <node-id> [-direction forward|reverse] [-max-nodes N] [-target id] [-concept term] [-diff d|-diff-path f] [-db path]
example: graphi analyze impact -symbol a1b2c3d4 -direction reverse -db graph.db

--- graphi help architecture ---
graphi architecture — [labs] automatic architecture view: Louvain communities layered by dependency direction (labs)
usage:   graphi architecture [-max-items n]
example: graphi architecture

--- graphi help architecture-violations ---
graphi architecture-violations — [labs] cycles, back-edges, high coupling, god modules on the community graph (labs)
usage:   graphi architecture-violations [-max-items n]
example: graphi architecture-violations

--- graphi help batched ---
graphi batched — [labs] run a registered analyzer over the graph
usage:   graphi analyze <analyzer> -symbol <node-id> [-direction forward|reverse] [-max-nodes N] [-target id] [-concept term] [-diff d|-diff-path f] [-db path]
example: graphi analyze impact -symbol a1b2c3d4 -direction reverse -db graph.db

--- graphi help callees ---
graphi callees — structural query over the graph (callers|callees|references|definition|neighborhood)
usage:   graphi query <op> -symbol <node-id> [-depth N] [-db path] [-daemon socket]
example: graphi query callers -symbol a1b2c3d4 -db ~/.graphi/graph.db

--- graphi help callers ---
graphi callers — structural query over the graph (callers|callees|references|definition|neighborhood)
usage:   graphi query <op> -symbol <node-id> [-depth N] [-db path] [-daemon socket]
example: graphi query callers -symbol a1b2c3d4 -db ~/.graphi/graph.db

--- graphi help change-impact ---
graphi change-impact — [labs] Change Risk 2.0: changed symbols, public API, dependents, covering tests, reasons, risk (labs)
usage:   graphi change-impact [-db path] [-depth 1-3] [-max-items n] (<target> | -diff <file|->)
example: git diff HEAD~1..HEAD | graphi change-impact -diff -

--- graphi help change-risk ---
graphi change-risk — evidence-based local blast-radius estimate (low/medium/high/unknown)
usage:   graphi change-risk [-db path] [-max-items n] (<target> | -diff <file|->)
example: git diff | graphi change-risk -db graph.db -diff -

--- graphi help claude ---
graphi claude — [labs] register graphi's MCP server in Claude Code (alias for `setup`)
usage:   graphi claude [--dry-run]
example: graphi claude

--- graphi help communities ---
graphi communities — [labs] run a registered analyzer over the graph
usage:   graphi analyze <analyzer> -symbol <node-id> [-direction forward|reverse] [-max-nodes N] [-target id] [-concept term] [-diff d|-diff-path f] [-db path]
example: graphi analyze impact -symbol a1b2c3d4 -direction reverse -db graph.db

--- graphi help compare ---
graphi compare — [labs] diff two named graph states (snapshot names, or 'current' for the live graph)
usage:   graphi compare <base> <head> [-root <repo>]
example: graphi compare main current

--- graphi help compare-branches ---
graphi compare-branches — [labs] graph-level diff of two graphi SQLite snapshots (paths, never git refs)
usage:   graphi compare-branches -base <db-path> -head <db-path>
example: graphi compare-branches -base base-graph.db -head head-graph.db

--- graphi help compound ---
graphi compound — [labs] compound / Cypher-style graph query (SEED/HOP/WHERE/MAXDEPTH)
usage:   graphi compound [-db path] [-daemon socket] -q "SEED ..." (or query text on stdin)
example: graphi compound -db graph.db -q 'SEED kind=function\nHOP calls'

graphi concept — [labs] run a registered analyzer over the graph

--- graphi help critique-review ---
graphi critique-review — [labs] graph-evidence critique of an existing PR review
usage:   graphi critique-review [-db path] -diff <d>|-diff-path <f> [-pr N] [-review <json>|-review-path <f>]
example: graphi critique-review -db graph.db -diff-path change.diff -review-path review.json

--- graphi help daemon ---
graphi daemon — [labs] hot-index Unix-socket daemon lifecycle
usage:   graphi daemon start|stop|status [-socket path] [-db path]
example: graphi daemon start -socket /tmp/graphi.sock -db graph.db

--- graphi help diagnose ---
graphi diagnose — [labs] graph-derived diagnostics + suggested code-actions (high-confidence by default)
usage:   graphi diagnose [-db path] [-daemon socket] [-all] [-confidence confirmed|derived|heuristic] [-severity error|warning|info] [-explain-suppressed] [-json] [-root dir] [<kind>...]
example: graphi diagnose -db graph.db -severity warning dead_symbol

--- graphi help distill ---
graphi distill — [labs] distill a session into a compact decision record
usage:   graphi distill -session <id> [-decisions d1,d2] [-risks r1] [-questions q1] [-files a.go,b.go] [-ledger path]
example: graphi distill -session s1 -decisions "use sqlite" -files core/graphstore/sqlite.go

--- graphi help doctor ---
graphi doctor — [labs] read-only diagnostic checkup for binary, PATH, MCP clients, DB, privacy, and local-first invariants
usage:   graphi doctor [-db path] [--json]
example: graphi doctor --json

--- graphi help explain-symbol ---
graphi explain-symbol — compact, cited symbol identity summary (definition, callers, callees, references)
usage:   graphi explain-symbol [-db path] [-max-items n] <symbol|path|node-id>
example: graphi explain-symbol -db graph.db util.Format

--- graphi help index ---
graphi index — ingest a repo into a durable store (advanced long form of sync/rebuild; --full forces a cold pass; optional --semantic embedding pass)
usage:   graphi index [-root <repo>] [-db path] [-meta dir] [--full] [--semantic]
example: graphi index -root . -db ~/.graphi/graph.db -meta ~/.graphi/meta

example: graphi inline -root . -dry-run a1b2c3d4

--- graphi help mcp ---
graphi mcp — [labs] MCP stdio server (Stable tools by default; explicit -labs opt-in for experimental tools); -root or the GRAPHI_ROOT env var (flag wins) pins the repository root for clients that launch the server outside the repo and supply no MCP roots; with -db, -meta names the sidecar dir like the CLI verbs
usage:   graphi mcp [-root <repo>] [-db path [-meta dir]] [-daemon socket] [-labs]
example: graphi mcp -root ~/work/mars

--- graphi help memory ---
graphi memory — [labs] agent memory operations
usage:   graphi memory store|recall|forget|list|export [-scope s] [-notebook n] [-payload text] [-tags a,b] [-id id] [-kind k] [-source s] [-confidence c] [-evidence e] [-limit N] [-path file] [-ledger path]
example: graphi memory store -scope repo -notebook decisions -payload "we chose sqlite" -source architect -confidence confirmed

--- graphi help query ---
graphi query — structural query over the graph (callers|callees|references|definition|neighborhood)

example: graphi query callers -symbol a1b2c3d4 -db ~/.graphi/graph.db

--- graphi help query-strict ---
graphi query-strict — [labs] run a stable query, then exclude result edges below a confidence tier; excluded counts stay visible (filtered emptiness is never bare emptiness), optional fail-closed policy preflight
usage:   graphi query-strict <operation> -symbol <id> [-depth n] [-min-tier confirmed|derived|heuristic] [-policy exploratory-v1|review-v1|automated-change-v1] [-db path]
example: graphi query-strict callers -symbol shop.price -min-tier derived

--- graphi help rebuild ---
graphi rebuild — re-index the repo from scratch (cold full pass — for a damaged index, after an upgrade, or when doctor recommends it)
usage:   graphi rebuild [-root <repo>] [-db path] [-meta dir] [-profile name]
example: graphi rebuild

--- graphi help refactor ---
graphi refactor — [labs] commit a refactor through the atomic edit saga
usage:   graphi refactor -root <repo> [-db path] [-meta dir] -kind <k> -target <id> -old-name X -new-name Y [-actor who]
example: graphi refactor -root . -kind rename -target a1b2 -old-name Foo -new-name Bar

--- graphi help refactor-preview ---
graphi refactor-preview — [labs] impact-set preview of a refactor, no mutation
usage:   graphi refactor-preview -root <repo> [-db path] [-meta dir] -kind <k> -target <id> -old-name X -new-name Y
example: graphi refactor-preview -root . -kind rename -target a1b2 -old-name Foo -new-name Bar

--- graphi help references ---
graphi references — structural query over the graph (callers|callees|references|definition|neighborhood)
usage:   graphi query <op> -symbol <node-id> [-depth N] [-db path] [-daemon socket]
example: graphi query callers -symbol a1b2c3d4 -db ~/.graphi/graph.db

--- graphi help related-files ---
graphi related-files — ranked, cited read-first file list around a symbol, path, or task
usage:   graphi related-files [-db path] [-direction dependencies|dependents|both] [-max-files n] <target>
example: graphi related-files -db graph.db -direction dependents util.Format

--- graphi help repo-overview ---
graphi repo-overview — [labs] one-call repository summary: structure, languages, entrypoints, central symbols, tests, boundaries (labs)
usage:   graphi repo-overview [-db path] [-max-items n] [-communities]
example: graphi repo-overview -communities

--- graphi help safe-delete ---
graphi safe-delete — [labs] reference-safety-gated delete (removes the declaration line only)
usage:   graphi safe-delete -root <repo> [-db path] [-meta dir] [-dry-run] <target-node-id>
example: graphi safe-delete -root . -dry-run a1b2c3d4

--- graphi help savings ---
graphi savings — [labs] session token-savings readout from a ledger a prior MCP/daemon session wrote
usage:   graphi savings -ledger <path> [-db path] [-daemon socket]
example: graphi savings -ledger ~/.graphi/ledger.db

--- graphi help search ---
graphi search — lexical / symbol search; -semantic runs the optional embedding search
usage:   graphi search [-limit N] [-semantic] <query> [-db path] [-daemon socket] [-meta dir]
example: graphi search -db graph.db -limit 10 parseFile

--- graphi help search-ast ---
graphi search-ast — [labs] structural AST pattern query
usage:   graphi search-ast [-limit N] <json-pattern> [-db path]
example: graphi search-ast -db graph.db '{"kind":"function","name":{"regex":"^handle"}}'

--- graphi help search-hybrid ---
graphi search-hybrid — [labs] embedding-free hybrid search: identifier segments + path + graph degree (labs)
usage:   graphi search-hybrid [-max-items n] <query text>
example: graphi search-hybrid "authentication token validation"

--- graphi help setup ---
graphi setup — [labs] register graphi's MCP stdio server into local MCP clients' configs; --project instead writes the repo's .mcp.json with the session root pinned (mcp -root), or with --attach the auto-managed per-repo store pinned (mcp -db/-meta)
usage:   graphi setup [--client claude|copilot|cursor|devin|windsurf|claude-desktop|all] [--dry-run] [--binary path] [--config path] | graphi setup --project [--root <repo>] [--attach]
example: graphi setup --project

--- graphi help setup-embedder ---
graphi setup-embedder — [labs] print how to opt in to the optional semantic search (offline)
usage:   graphi setup-embedder [<selector>]
example: graphi setup-embedder ollama

--- graphi help skillgen ---
graphi skillgen — [labs] deterministic skill generation from a procedure description
usage:   graphi skillgen -name <n> -trigger <t> [-description <d>] [-ledger path]
example: graphi skillgen -name reindex -trigger "after big refactor" -description "run graphi index"

--- graphi help snapshot ---
graphi snapshot — [labs] list, freeze, or delete named graph states of this repo (for graphi compare)
usage:   graphi snapshot [<name> | -rm <name>] [-root <repo>]
example: graphi snapshot main

--- graphi help status ---
graphi status — report whether the graph matches the checked-out code (read-only; exit 0 current, 1 actionable, 2 error)
usage:   graphi status [--json] [-root <repo>] [-db path] [-meta dir]
example: graphi status --json

example: graphi query callers -symbol a1b2c3d4 -db ~/.graphi/graph.db

--- graphi help suggest-reviewers ---
graphi suggest-reviewers — [labs] ranked candidate-reviewer recommender for a touched set
usage:   graphi suggest-reviewers [-db path] -diff <unified-diff|refs> | -diff-path <file>
example: graphi suggest-reviewers -db graph.db -diff-path change.diff

graphi supertypes — [labs] structural query over the graph (callers|callees|references|definition|neighborhood)

example: graphi query callers -symbol a1b2c3d4 -db ~/.graphi/graph.db

--- graphi help symbol-context ---
graphi symbol-context — [labs] unified single-call symbol view: definition + snippet, hierarchy, callers/callees/references, covering tests, risk (labs)
usage:   graphi symbol-context [-db path] [-depth 1-3] [-max-items n] [-token-budget n] <symbol|path|node-id>
example: graphi symbol-context util.Format

--- graphi help sync ---
graphi sync — bring the graph up to date with the checked-out code (incremental, flagless; run it after a branch switch)
usage:   graphi sync [-root <repo>] [-db path] [-meta dir] [-profile name]
example: git switch feature/login && graphi sync

--- graphi help taint ---
graphi taint — [labs] run a registered analyzer over the graph
usage:   graphi analyze <analyzer> -symbol <node-id> [-direction forward|reverse] [-max-nodes N] [-target id] [-concept term] [-diff d|-diff-path f] [-db path]
example: graphi analyze impact -symbol a1b2c3d4 -direction reverse -db graph.db

--- graphi help taint-query ---
graphi taint-query — [labs] run a registered analyzer over the graph
usage:   graphi analyze <analyzer> -symbol <node-id> [-direction forward|reverse] [-max-nodes N] [-target id] [-concept term] [-diff d|-diff-path f] [-db path]
example: graphi analyze impact -symbol a1b2c3d4 -direction reverse -db graph.db

--- graphi help task-context ---
graphi task-context — [labs] free-text task → ranked, cited, token-budgeted context bundle with read order (labs)
usage:   graphi task-context [-db path] [-max-items n] [-token-budget n] <task text>
example: graphi task-context "add validation to createOrder"

--- graphi help test-impact ---
graphi test-impact — [labs] which tests must run for a change: must_run / recommended / probably_unaffected / unknown (labs)
usage:   graphi test-impact [-db path] [-depth 1-3] [-max-items n] (<target> | -diff <file|->)
example: git diff HEAD~1..HEAD | graphi test-impact -diff -

--- graphi help triage-prs ---
graphi triage-prs — [labs] graph-derived multi-PR triage ranking
usage:   graphi triage-prs [-db path] [-daemon socket]
example: GITHUB_TOKEN=... GITHUB_REPOSITORY=owner/repo graphi triage-prs -db graph.db

--- graphi help trust-report ---
graphi trust-report — [labs] report the graph's trust surface: snapshot state, confidence tiers, coverage gaps, boundaries, optional policy verdict (read-only; exit 0 PASS/current, 1 WARN, 2 error, 3 FAIL, 4 UNKNOWN/unavailable)
usage:   graphi trust-report [--json] [--details] [--limit n] [--target <symbol|path|package>] [--policy exploratory-v1|review-v1|automated-change-v1] [-root <repo>] [-db path] [-meta dir]
example: graphi trust-report --policy review --json

--- graphi help ui ---
graphi ui — [labs] index the current repo and open the local graph UI (alias for bare `graphi`)
usage:   graphi ui
example: graphi ui

--- graphi help undo ---
graphi undo — [labs] reverse an applied edit by its undo token
usage:   graphi undo -root <repo> [-db path] [-meta dir] -token <undo-token> [-actor who]
example: graphi undo -root . -token 01HXYZ...

--- graphi help upgrade ---
graphi upgrade — [labs] user-initiated self-update to the latest release (never automatic)
usage:   graphi upgrade [-print]
example: graphi upgrade -print

--- graphi help version ---
graphi version — [labs] print version / commit / build date stamped into the binary
usage:   graphi version
example: graphi version

--- graphi help watcher-status ---
graphi watcher-status — [labs] run a registered analyzer over the graph
usage:   graphi analyze <analyzer> -symbol <node-id> [-direction forward|reverse] [-max-nodes N] [-target id] [-concept term] [-diff d|-diff-path f] [-db path]
example: graphi analyze impact -symbol a1b2c3d4 -direction reverse -db graph.db
